title: Qwen3 run manifest (v2)
description: Schema cho manifest Qwen3 trong manifests_qwen3/. Khac schema V1 o cho: (a) bat buoc co `regenerable` va `limitation` de noi ro thu gi khong kiem chung duoc, (b) `dataset_sha256` kem `dataset_sha256_scope` vi hash phu thuoc loai details, (c) `scorer_status` phai noi ro scorer co con tren dia hay khong.

run_id.description: sinh tu ten file + dataset_sha256; bat bien giup phat hien manifest bi sao chep.

model_path_kind.description: Cho biet 'model' la ten trong Ollama hay basename cua thu muc dia. Duong dan may-lab khong duoc commit; chi giu basename.

dataset_sha256.description: sha256 cua noi dung da cham thuc su. Pham vi chinh xac nam o dataset_sha256_scope.

dataset_sha256_scope.description: Bắt buộc: hash bao phu cai gi. Voi schema 'harness' chi khop tap cau, KHONG khop noi dung cau.

scorer.description: duong dan tuong doi trong repo nay, hoac null neu khong xac dinh duoc.

scorer_sha256.description: Hash cua script LUC CHAY -- nguon cua so lieu. Khong doi khi script bi sua sau do; ban moi ghi o current_sha256.

current_sha256.description: Hash cua ban script dang nam tren dia. Khac scorer_sha256 nghia la da sua sau khi sinh so lieu.

modified_after_run.description: true nghia la script bi sua sau khi sinh ra so lieu; phai kem modification.

modification.description: Ly do sua, va cho biet du lieu co bi anh huong khong.

generator_evidence.description: Tai sao tin script nay sinh ra manifest nay. Moi mapping can it nhat 2 bang chung doc lap (schema + tag/mau OUT/mtime). Khong co thi scorer=null.

generator_version.description: Ban script nao trong cac ban da biet (v_orig/v_exp/v_text cua gsm_sweep). Chi dung khi xac dinh duoc bang dac diem.

generator_features.description: Dac diem cua ban do (dong OUT, truong details) de nguoi doc tu kiem.

version_note.description: Ghi ro khi lab khong co git: khong chung minh duoc file hien tai giong ban luc chay.

timestamp_source.description: timestamp lay tu mtime file manifest, KHONG phai gio chay that.

dataset_source.description: Hash noi dung dataset tai dung tu NGUON GOC (HF dataset), khong tu `details`. Khi co, hash chung minh duoc ca chi so lan noi dung cau; khi null, chi `dataset_sha256` yeu hon van dung.

regenerable.description: Tat ca manifest Qwen3 deu can GPU. Hang nay ton tai de nguoi doc khong tuong lai nham tinh lai tu 0.
